parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let your shoulders drop, away from your ears. <short pause> Unclench your jaw. <short pause> Let the mattress hold you. <short pause> Breathe in slowly through your nose... and out through your mouth. <short pause> Again, slow and easy.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The room is quiet now. <short pause> The day has ended. <short pause> Maybe you feel the loneliness of the hour... the weight of being by yourself. <short pause> But here is the truth that meets you tonight. <short pause> You are not alone.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The Lord is with you in this room, at this moment. <short pause> He knows your name... and he knows this night. <short pause> He sees you. <short pause> Take another slow breath.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: In the darkness, his presence is real. <short pause> Not an idea, or a memory... but a living presence. <short pause> Closer than the air you breathe. <short pause> The God who made the stars is here with you now. <short pause> He does not hurry. <short pause> He does not turn away. <short pause> He stays. <short pause> Breathe in his nearness. <short pause> Breathe out the loneliness.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Scripture tells us something beautiful about this.

And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed. <short pause> Deuteronomy, chapter thirty-one, verse eight. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: He goes before you into tomorrow. <short pause> He is with you in this quiet now. <short pause> He will never leave you... never forsake you. <short pause> He will be with you. <short pause> Let those words settle over you like a blanket. <short pause> He will be with you. <short pause> Not might be. Not could be. <short pause> Will be.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: His promise does not change with your feelings. <short pause> It does not waver when you feel small, or forgotten. <short pause> He is here. <short pause> Breathe slowly again. <short pause> Feel the stillness around you. <short pause> In this stillness, God is present.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: He knows what this day held. <short pause> He knows the ache of the evening. <short pause> And he has not left you to carry it alone. <short pause> You can rest now. <short pause> You can let go of the striving, the worry, the need to be strong. <short pause> He is strong for you. <short pause> He holds this night. <short pause> He holds you.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: As you close your eyes, know this. <short pause> You are seen. You are known. You are loved. <short pause> And you are not alone tonight.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May the Lord bless you, and keep you. <short pause> May he make his face shine upon you, and give you peace. <short pause> Now... and through the night.
